title: Recurrences

empty.title: No recurrences found
empty.description: Adjust the filters or create a new recurrence.

create.title: New recurrence
create.description: Creates the rule and generates the upcoming occurrences (up to 12 months at a time).

edit.title: Edit recurrence
edit.description: Changes only affect occurrences that are still in the future and pending.

createCredit.title: New recurring card expense
createCredit.description: Creates the rule and generates the upcoming occurrences (up to 12 months at a time).

editCredit.title: Edit recurring card expense
editCredit.description: Changes only affect occurrences that are still in the future and pending.

delete.title: Delete recurrence?
delete.description: Occurrences that are still in the future and pending will also be deleted. Past or already-completed occurrences stay in your history. This action cannot be undone.

startDate.label: Start date
startDate.editHelp: Changing the date only affects future occurrences that haven't been generated yet. This month's occurrence stays the same.

endDate.toggleHelp: If off, the recurrence continues indefinitely.
endDate.label: End date

splits.needsPersonFirst: Choose a person above to split
splits.mismatch: The split total must match the recurrence amount

scheduleSummary: Repeats {frequency}. Frequency can't be changed after creation — delete and create a new one to change it.

toast.extended: {count, plural, one {# more occurrence generated} other {# more occurrences generated}}
toast.advanced: Occurrence advanced and marked as paid

errors.noPendingOccurrence: There's no pending occurrence to advance.
